items.reason: The design is registered as model PARALLEL, NON_RANDOMIZED with two EXPERIMENTAL arms ('Phase 1b', 'Phase 2'), both paxalisib + temozolomide, and neither works as a control. The manual defines 'no' as more than one arm with none working as a control. 'not_applicable' is reserved for single-arm trials.

note: The 'Phase 1b' and 'Phase 2' arms are effectively stages of one seamless single-regimen trial. If XL treats them as single-arm, the value becomes not_applicable; nothing else depends on it. Matched selection rests on two PTEN_PI3K enrichment cohorts (PIK3CA/PIK3R1 hyperactivating mutations; PTEN two-hit loss), both matched to paxalisib. Priority-3 MGMT role (eligibility vs enrichment): unmethylated MGMT applies to the Phase 1b front-line cohort, which is enrichment ('required for a cohort or arm'). MGMT is not candidate-matched either way.
